notes.title: 2.0 Beta 3
notes.content:
[h2]⚙️ General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed using Rage during warmup.  
[*] Removed Rage in [b]Survivor[/b] mode.  
[*] Removed the old-style menus bound to [b]M[/b] and [b]B[/b].  
[*] Improved the automatic game mode launch system.  
[*] Removed the Rage rune.  
[*] Improved the map voting algorithm and fixed visual glitches.  
[*] Daily missions are now hidden from the main interface once completed.  
[*] Adjusted the rune interface.  
[*] When using [b]ADS[/b] with weapons, accuracy is no longer available until most of the animation is completed.  
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented purchasing points when having the exact amount of Carnage credits.  
[*] Fixed an issue where playtime was not being saved correctly.  
[/list]

[h2]🕹️ Specific Modes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Round duration now scales with kills:  
   [list]  
   [*] Start: [b]30 seconds[/b].  
   [*] +20 seconds per kill.  
   [*] Maximum: [b]60 seconds[/b].  
   [*] Affects: [b]Killer / Synapsis / Assassin / Daylight Assassin / Armageddon[/b].  
   [/list]
[/list]

[h2]🆕 New Mode: [b]Chipansis[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Number of killers: [b]3[/b].  
[*] Killers do not have [b]RPGs[/b].  
[*] Wooden planks and laser mines cannot be placed.  
[*] Every 5 human kills as a killer → you return to human and gain [b]1 event point[/b] (if active).  
[*] Each killer eliminated grants [b]1 event point[/b].  
[/list]

[h2]🗺️ Maps[/h2]

[b]Boxcolors[/b]  
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of the upper base with 3 pipes.  
[*] Added more convenient supports for placing planks on the 3-pipe base.  
[*] Removed collisions on certain tall signs.  
[*] Adjusted the position of the dark sign.  
[/list]

[b]Abandoned Village[/b]  
[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues.  
[*] Improved some bases.  
[*] Added more ladders to access additional rooftops.  
[/list]

[b]Azkin Dungeon[/b]  
[list]
[*] Collision adjustments.  
[*] Improvements to some bases.  
[*] Adjusted doors for better accessibility.  
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
[h2]New Battle Pass[/h2]

We have added a new Battle Pass system consisting of 40 levels. For this month only, all rewards will be free. In future Battle Passes, some level rewards will be free, while others will be exclusive to those who purchased the Battle Pass.

You can level up the Battle Pass by playing rounds or completing missions that grant Battle Pass XP. We'll add new missions weekly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/0450a9c6c2b04ab460ed874adf77489239fbd005.png[/img]
[h2]Easter Event[/h2]

By collecting easter eggs, you will be able to unlock two exclusive weapon skins: Easter Fire Rifle / Easter Frost Rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/5e14046a029427b33210f13b6cd0eb715a5a1349.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map Vote[/h2]

Now, after the last round ends, a new user interface will allow players to vote for the next map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/326e555444e0377b2f7608d0ad6d0b2fd2231847.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Mission Types[/h2]

We've added a few new mission types, including winning a Tic Tac Toe mini-game hidden in some parts of the maps.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We've increased AP rewards for Human and Zombie for the Bloodhell world

notes.title: Update 1.13.0
notes.content:
[h1]Nilan[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/dc2d9d3f3295e3b50e0cc74dee20c1ddc71aede0.jpg[/img]
Our latest map, situated in the middle east, is now available to play!

[h1]Human Skins[/h1]
We have introduced preliminary support for Human Skins. The UI and system aren't fully finished yet, but we wanted to give you an early access to this feature.

In addition, we will be giving 3 exclusive human skins as a reward for players that have been with us for a long time. These skins will not be able to be obtained by any means in the future. The only way to get them is to meet the following requirements:

Carl Legacy: Have played at least once
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/f8a777c28ad3572d908af5d7e1dd037dd8d335b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/5746c65325fb8c4e342d184c7f838529289d0761.png[/img][/url]
Jake Legacy: Have at least 1 reset
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/08fa093f712877857e27195c21c49d95d4f8c914.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/cedb8bf774993e787375033f2bb69d2805bb8b3e.png[/img][/url]
Rick Legacy: Have at least 10 resets
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/ec15d4d9c264dea6a2622e84e955808c69d61aa0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/7ab58a6c3c1e3a7360a29e3e4bdda36005f338fa.png[/img][/url]

[b]You have until 2022-12-14 23:59 UTC to meet these requirements.[/b]. If by that date you've met the requirements for some or all of those skins, they will be given to you. After that, it will not be possible to obtain these skins.

tags.feature: Our latest map, situated in the middle east, is now available to play!

notes.title: Zombie Carnage 2 Roadmap
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody that played Zombie Carnage 2 on release!

I want to briefly outline our short term roadmap, and mention a bit of what we're working on.

[h3]Coming over the next few days[/h3]
[list]
[*] Important bug fixes as they appear
[*] Balance changes (difficulty, health, damage, etc)
[*] Important map fixes
[*] Dedicated Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (Latam) locales. Other locales will be coming in a few months.
[/list]

[h3]Coming very soon (~2 weeks)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapon and character skins: This was supposed to land on release but got delayed unfortunately
[*]New map: We have a couple of maps almost ready that will be landing very soon
[*]Optimization improvements: We're very focused on great performance and there are some big changes that didn't make it in time. Some specific modes have a big toll on both client and server performance, and we're working to fix it.
[/list]


[h3]Coming soon (1-2 months)[/h3]
[list]
[*] New weapons and attachments
[*] New zombie classes with new game mechanics
[*] Additional content
[/list]

This is not an exhaustive list, and many more changes will be included.

Thank you for your patience and support!
